_comment: Ledger of third-party facts the skill depends on (client config paths, timeouts, budgets, SDK/API shapes, CI runtimes). Each entry records WHERE the fact was read and WHEN. scripts/verify_docs_sync.py asserts: every subject in `required_subjects` has an entry, every entry has an https source and a valid date, every `affects` path exists, and entries older than `max_age_days` are ::warning in CI and FAIL under --strict-staleness (the weekly docs-currency workflow files an issue). Re-verify = re-read the source, update `fact` if it changed, bump `verified_on`, and fix the code/docs in `affects` — that is the whole institution (AGENTS §2 v3).

facts.subject: claude-code
facts.fact: `claude mcp add --transport http|sse|stdio --scope local|project|user -e KEY=V -- cmd`; `.mcp.json` supports ${VAR} / ${VAR:-default} and per-server `timeout` (ms); tool and property names 1–64 chars; MCP output capped by MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS (25000); idle stdio servers reaped after 30 min; plugin manifests may declare mcpServers as .mcpb paths and use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} / userConfig.

facts.subject: claude-desktop
facts.fact: claude_desktop_config.json under ~/Library/Application Support/Claude (macOS) / %APPDATA%\Claude (Windows); .mcpb bundles install via Settings → Extensions; GUI clients do not inherit the shell PATH (absolute `uv` path required).

facts.subject: codex
facts.fact: config.toml [mcp_servers.<name>]: startup_timeout_sec default 10, tool_timeout_sec default 60, `env` table sets vars, `env_vars` forwards Codex's own env (older Codex rejects unknown keys in the table — do not write env_vars); default env whitelist HOME LOGNAME PATH SHELL USER __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR TZ; Codex 0.158.0 (2026-09-28) added tool_input_schema_max_bytes default 5000 (oversize inputSchema is compacted: descriptions stripped) and startup_readiness = "catalog".

facts.subject: cursor
facts.fact: ~/.cursor/mcp.json (global) and .cursor/mcp.json (project); placeholders ${workspaceFolder} ${workspaceFolderBasename} ${env:X} ${userHome} ${pathSeparator}; deep link cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=&config=base64; docs table lists `type` (stdio) though examples omit it; ~40-tool practical cap (older observation, not on the docs page).

facts.subject: vscode
facts.fact: .vscode/mcp.json root key `servers`, `type` required, placeholders ${workspaceFolder} ${env:X} ${userHome} ${input:id}; new sandbox fields; 128-tool ceiling shared across servers (Copilot).

facts.subject: zed
facts.fact: settings.json `context_servers.<name>` = {command, args (optional since 2026-06), env, timeout (seconds, default 60)}; no `source` field; global context_server_timeout 60.

facts.subject: gemini
facts.fact: ~/.gemini/settings.json and project .gemini/settings.json `mcpServers`; per-server `timeout` in ms (default 600000), `trust` default false; tool FQN is unconditionally mcp_{serverName}_{toolName}, names over 63 chars are middle-truncated; $schema/additionalProperties stripped from schemas.

facts.subject: windsurf
facts.fact: Windsurf was renamed Devin Desktop on 2026-06-02; Cascade was removed in v3.9.19 (2026-09-08) and Devin Local is the only agent. It reads the Devin CLI MCP files: ~/.config/devin/mcp_config.json (macOS/Linux), %APPDATA%\devin\mcp_config.json (Windows), project .devin/mcp_config.json (+ .devin/mcp_config.local.json); root key mcpServers; stdio fields command/args/env/disabled; no per-server timeout. Legacy Cascade read ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json with a 100-tool cap. UNVERIFIED: whether Devin Local still reads the legacy `.windsurf/rules/*.md` rules files — the repo keeps that mirror until a Devin rules path is documented.

facts.subject: cline
facts.fact: cline_mcp_settings.json under the host editor's globalStorage/saoudrizwan.claude-dev/settings/; per-server `timeout` in seconds, default 60, range 1–3600; `type: stdio`; CLI also reads ~/.cline/mcp.json.

facts.subject: openclaw
facts.fact: OpenClaw consumes MCP through mcporter (npm, 0.9.0): `mcporter call <server>.<tool> --config <mcporter.json> --timeout <ms>`; first `npx mcporter` run downloads the package plus a native rolldown binding (~2 min on Windows runners); `mcporter` may hang after printing a result when a child server keeps stdio open (docs/hang-debug.md); MCPORTER_DEBUG_HANG=1 dumps handles.

facts.subject: remote-connectors
facts.fact: claude.ai custom connectors accept only OAuth (client id/secret), no static Bearer; ChatGPT remote MCP requires OAuth (CIMD; DCR still supported when configured) and search/fetch tools for deep research. The skill offers a static Bearer over streamable-http, so both need an OAuth-terminating HTTPS gateway.

facts.subject: mcp-python-sdk
facts.fact: Latest 1.x is 1.30.0 (2026-09-07): `streamablehttp_client(url, headers=…)` deprecated in favour of `streamable_http_client(url, http_client=httpx.AsyncClient)`; pydantic >= 2.11; idle streamable-http sessions closed after 30 min (session_idle_timeout), 10000-session cap; LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION 2025-11-25 while the spec's latest revision is 2026-07-28.

facts.subject: mcpb
facts.fact: @anthropic-ai/mcpb latest 2.1.2 (2025-12-04); manifest_version 0.4 with `uv` server type, optional privacy_policies / compatibility / user_config; `npx mcpb validate` + `mcpb pack`; packing is not byte-reproducible (sha must come from the uploaded build).

facts.subject: github-actions
facts.fact: Node 20 was removed from GitHub-hosted runners on 2026-09-23; JavaScript actions run on Node 24 and the ACTIONS_ALLOW_USE_UNSECURE_NODE_VERSION opt-out is gone. Node-24 majors used here: checkout v5, setup-python v6, setup-node v5, upload-artifact v6, download-artifact v7, cache v5, astral-sh/setup-uv v7, attest-build-provenance v3, codeql-action v4, dependency-review-action v5. Avoid download-artifact v8 (no auto-unzip, digest mismatch errors) and setup-uv v10 (cache disabled on release/pull_request_target/workflow_run) until validated on a draft matrix.

facts.subject: github-runner-images
facts.fact: macos-latest = macOS 26 arm64 (default Python 3.14, cached 3.12); windows-latest = windows-2025 (Python 3.12.10, Node 22, pwsh 7.6); windows-11-arm re-imaged 2026-09-21..30 (default Node 24 / Python 3.13, cached 3.12.10, no uv); ubuntu-latest moves to 26.04 in 2026-11. The workflows pin Python 3.12 and Node 22 explicitly.

facts.subject: uv
facts.fact: uv 0.12.14–0.12.20 (2026-09): no semantic change to `uvx --from <wheel URL|path>`; direct-URL dependencies are cached by URL and re-validated per HTTP cache headers (hence the local wheel cache in ~/.horosa/wheels/); 0.12.16 hash-verifies downloads; Windows MAX_PATH fix in 0.12.14.

facts.subject: node
facts.fact: Node 22 is Maintenance LTS until 2027-04-30 (payload ships the latest-v22.x line); Node 24 Active LTS; Node 26 enters LTS on 2026-10-28.

facts.subject: python
facts.fact: Python 3.12 is the runtime floor (requires-python >= 3.12) and the embedded payload interpreter; 3.13 is the default on the new windows-11-arm image, so workflows pin 3.12 explicitly.

facts.subject: swisseph
facts.fact: Swiss Ephemeris (libswe, built into pyswisseph) declares all of its state (ephemeris path, open files, sidereal mode) TLS: sweodef.h defines TLS as __thread (GCC) / __declspec(thread) (MSVC) unless __APPLE__, WIN32, DOS32 or TLSOFF is defined. A setuptools/MSVC build only has _WIN32, so on Windows swe_set_ephe_path applies to the calling thread only; on macOS the state is process-wide. Upstream v3.11.2's HOROSA_EPHE_PATH_FASTPATH caches 'path set' process-wide, so the Windows launcher turns it off (verified on windows-latest + windows-11-arm, diag runs 36802700937 / 36803364178).
